lyrics: kEndhAvarEy polva pAdhangalnidha ranga - dhim dhimi dhimi kEndhu kuNiyuthali
andhigE kirugejjE ghalu ghalurEnnalu - chEndhadhi peethAmbaradhoLu nalidhAdutha
kOtisoorya prakAshadhanthe - kireeTa kundala bhAvuLi poLEya
lalATa kasthoori thilakaviduvE ranga - kootagopAlara aata saako eega
yENNoorigathirasa dhadhighruthavo ranga - yEnnayya ninagEy koduvEy bAro
chinnara odanATa sAku bido ranga - bENNEya mEluvudhu bEdalEnna kandha
thurubina mElE naliyuthaliruthiha - marugumalligE jAji thuLasiya dhandEy
karadhali pididhu pongoLanEy oodhutha - sarasadhindhali nee nalidhAdutha
mangalAthmaka mohanakAya ranga - sangeethalola sadhguNa sheela
anganEyarigElla athipriyanAdha - shubhAnga mooruthi purandhara viTTala
